name: Stay Awake
author: Elvis Gastelum
description: A mug in the bar that keeps the system awake (no screensaver, no idle lock): left-click toggles it, right-click cycles timed presets with a countdown

barWidget.description: Keep the system awake indefinitely or for a set time

schema.label: Timed presets (minutes)
schema.description: Comma-separated durations that right-click cycles through before turning off.

schema.label: Show countdown
schema.description: Show the time left next to the mug while a timed preset runs.
